description:
# Dalio Family Office Overview
[under: Dalio Family Office Overview] The Dalio Family Office (DFO) supports Barbara and Ray Dalio and their family in their ventures, investments, and philanthropic efforts under Dalio Philanthropies, which includes OceanX, Dalio Education, Endless Network, and the Beijing Dalio Foundation.
[under: Dalio Family Office Overview] The office is headquartered in Westport, CT with regional offices in New York City, Singapore, and Abu Dhabi.
[under: Position Summary] This role requires a regular presence in both our New York City and Westport, CT offices, with time split between the two locations based on business needs, in line with our 3 to 5 day a week in office policy.
[under: Day-to-day responsibilities would include a combination of the following] - Support secure connectivity for office and remote users, including Wi-Fi, Zscaler, Tailscale, AV/conferencing systems, and printing services.
[under: Illustrative Benefits] - Hybrid work environment
[under: Illustrative Benefits] - Free catered food services for in-office days
[under: Qualifications] - Working knowledge of Entra ID and Microsoft 365 in a hybrid identity environment
[under: Qualifications] - Experience operating in a global team; comfort coordinating across time zones and supporting users remotely
[under: Preferred Qualifications] - Experience within a fintech, financial services, or family office environment.
